people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed; because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.
translations.bsb: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
translations.kjv: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
translations.asv: If ye are reproached for the name of Christ, blessed are ye; because the Spirit of glory and the Spirit of God resteth upon you.
